questions.question: What was the case mix index for Highland Hospital in fiscal year 2025?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_hcai_case_mix_index.xlsx', sheet_name='Case Mix Index')
row = df[df['Hospital'] == 'HIGHLAND HOSPITAL']
result = float(row['FY2025'].values[0])

questions.question: Between Woodland Memorial Hospital and Sutter Davis Hospital, which facility had a higher case mix index in fiscal year 2025?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_hcai_case_mix_index.xlsx', sheet_name='Case Mix Index')
h1 = df[df['Hospital'] == 'WOODLAND MEMORIAL HOSPITAL']['FY2025'].values[0]
h2 = df[df['Hospital'] == 'SUTTER DAVIS HOSPITAL']['FY2025'].values[0]
result = 'WOODLAND MEMORIAL HOSPITAL' if h1 > h2 else 'SUTTER DAVIS HOSPITAL'

questions.question: Did Adventist Health Simi Valley maintain a case mix index above 1.50 in fiscal year 2024?
questions.program:
